A shadcn/ui primitive (new-york style): A styled text input (Input).

## Responsibilities
- Wraps none (plain input) with the project's Tailwind token classes.
- Exports the parts listed under Purpose.
- 22 lines. It has no project-specific logic: it imports only `cn` from `@/lib/utils` and other `ui` primitives.
